source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/brg/giraffeadults (all 6 menu pages downloaded fresh 2026-10-08; menus.tenkites.com robots.txt allows it); giraffe.net home page (robots allows all) for dish descriptions
notes: Fresh pages gave data identical to what was published (only the dates changed). Independent Playwright DOM read of all 315 dishes matched 235 of 236 published items exactly on calories, contains, could-also-include, gluten cereals and nuts, and the vegetarian/vegan icons (the 236th, Malfy Con Arancia Gin and Slimline Tonic, differs only by the page's doubled 'and and' that the script fixes). Calories-only chain: no other nutrient is printed. Newly held back (allergen row contradicts the dish name, nothing on the page settles it): Moroccan Caesar Salad (main menu and gluten-free menu: no fish marked) and Hazelnut Espresso Martini (no allergens). 4 'Vegan ...' dishes with milk/egg are marked ok because the page's own icon says vegan_no; 2 brownies have no gluten mark and Giraffe's own site lists them on its GF menus. Existing 15 hold-backs unchanged.
